path.data-description: the recess the C20 sits in. The connector is std/c20-inlet@1, composed.

The translucent handle, lit from within: green - a valid source is connected and the supply is operational; blinking amber - a problem with the supply; not illuminated - no power connected; blinking green - firmware is being updated; five green blinks at 4 Hz then off - a mismatch with the other supply. The codes are the R660's table 136 (dell/psu-1400w-ac-60mm@1); no rate is published for the amber fault or the firmware blink, so 1 Hz is a reading.

rect.data-description: the orange release latch, pressed to withdraw the supply
